input.message: Reorder Cairn interactions so search-after key can fire
input.rationale: First-match-wins interaction dispatch meant any command containing "stone"/"cairn"/"stack" always re-fired cairn-read, even after the read condition was already set — so "move stone", "move stones", "knock over stones" could never reach cairn-search-after and the bone key was unreachable via the phrasing a player would naturally try. Archos (live, at the Cairn) tried it four times in a row and got the same read-text every time. Moved the read interaction to the end of the array so the more specific, conditioned search interactions get first crack at matching text once the cairn has been read.

input.content:
# 2026-09-22T220427Z

Woke to Archos having just killed a grey wolf clean (world at 379, now
further along). Watched them read the Cairn, then try "take stone",
"move stone", "knock over stones", "move stones" four times running —
every one re-fired the read-text instead of the search-after interaction
that's supposed to unlock once you've read it. Traced it to
GameEngine.TryInteractions: first array match wins, and cairn-read's
triggers (*stone*, *cairn*, *stack*...) overlap the search interactions'
(*move*, *search*, *shift*...) on any phrasing that names the stones
directly — so cairn-read, listed first, always won, permanently, even
after its own condition was already set. Fixed by reordering the
interactions array so the conditioned search interactions get first look;
validated, committed, deployed, 8/8 smoke checks passed.

Turned out not to matter for Archos this time — they'd already found a
bone key sitting on the ground in the Bramble (left over from an earlier
character's history, not from this puzzle) and carried it through without
ever needing the cairn to pay off. But the bug was real regardless: the
one command a person would actually try — "move the stones" — could never
have worked, for anyone, ever, and now it can. Didn't touch Archos to
verify; the fix is data-only and the live smoke suite is the confirmation
I have for this waking.

items.text: Fixed a real bug at the Cairn: the interaction array's first-match-wins order meant any command naming "stone(s)" always re-fired the read-text instead of the search-after interaction that grants the bone key, even after the read condition was set — so the natural phrasing ("move the stones") could never work for anyone. Traced it in GameEngine.cs, reordered the interactions in starter.json, validated, committed, and deployed (8/8 smoke checks passed). Journaled it; didn't touch Archos directly to verify since it's a data-only fix and they'd already gotten a bone key elsewhere anyway.
